title: Book Three · Chapter 177: The New Helper
story:
A week later, Ronan stops at the workshop after his morning at the library.

He has not come for a paid shift. He is meeting Dad for the walk home to lunch.

A woman is at the front counter. She is older than Ronan and has a customer book open beside her.

“Can I help?” she asks.

“I am waiting for my dad.”

He gives Dad's name. The woman looks toward the back, then offers him the stool near the door.

Mr Sun comes forward with a finished piece. He introduces the new helper, then tells Ronan Dad needs a few more minutes.

Ronan sits down with his library book.

A customer comes in to collect a small shelf. The helper finds the name, then turns a paper cover toward the man.

She has drawn a little shelf on the outside. The man points to it and smiles.

“That one.”

Ronan watches her check the paper with Mr Sun. The shelf goes onto the counter, and she brings wrapping paper.

She keeps the customer's drawing inside its cover. The little picture on the outside stays easy to find.

After the man leaves, Ronan looks at the covers beside the book.

“Those help.”

“With similar pieces,” she says. “Names on this side. A quick picture on that one.”

She turns one over so he can see. Ronan nods.

“What if two pictures look the same?” he asks.

“The names are still here.”

She puts a finger beside the writing. Then she opens the cover so he can see the larger drawing inside.

“The little picture helps me find the cover. I still check the papers.”

Ronan looks at the two covers beside her book. From a distance, the shelves look almost alike.

He moves closer and sees a different little line at one end.

“I made separate piles on my first morning,” he says. “Names here, drawings over there.”

“More places to look.”

“Yes.”

She smiles and closes the cover. She puts the cover back beside her customer book. Ronan leaves her the space at the counter.

Ronan sits back on his stool. He can watch her find the next paper from there. His library book is still on his knees, and Dad will be ready for lunch soon. He used the same counter for weeks, but he did not use that space for a picture.

Dad comes to the front with his work bag. The helper asks him about one measurement before he leaves.

He answers and points to the checked mark on the drawing. Then he gives her the paper back.

Outside, Dad walks beside Ronan along the shop road.

“She is quick with the covers,” Ronan says.

“She has worked at another counter.”

“I liked her pictures.”

Dad smiles. “Mr Sun likes finding the right shelf.”

Ronan laughs. He looks back once. The helper is standing with another customer now. Mr Sun has returned to the bench.

At the busy corner, Dad waits while a cart turns. Ronan stands beside him with the book under one arm.

“Still glad you tried the summer work?” Dad asks.

“Yes. I still want more lessons.”

They cross together. Near the green door, Mum is leaving for her second sewing class.

She gives them a quick wave and turns toward the clothes shop. Dad opens the door for Ronan, and the two go in to find their lunch.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

shift＝一段排定的工作时间；cover＝纸套、外封；similar＝相似的；measurement＝尺寸。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan这次去店里是否有新工资？新帮手怎样改进找物品的办法？
2. Dad和Mum各自还在做什么？他们的生活是否必须围着Ronan以后离开来停下？

## 读句子

**The little picture on the outside stays easy to find.**

拆开看：The little picture / on the outside / stays easy to find.

那个小图／画在纸套外面／仍能一眼找到。
